scores.rationale: The pick is the cheapest of the 12 compliant options at $0.55 workload cost, undercutting the next cheapest (gemini-2.5-flash-lite at $0.70) while meeting all functional requirements, so it clearly offers strong capability for its workload cost.

The deliverable argues fit via tools, structured_outputs, 400k context, and reasoning support, but relies on catalog feature flags rather than evidence about reliability of structured output, latency, or real-world tool-calling quality.

The comparison quotes exact catalog prices ($0.55 workload, $0.05/$0.40 per 1M), names concrete alternatives with their costs, and explains trade-offs (context size, Qwen output pricing), though some claims like 'no proportional performance improvements' are asserted without evidence.
